name: limited_uses
question: Pawn:GetShotsRemaining (shots_remaining) counts limited uses plus 1 per unlimited skill, and drops when a limited weapon fires; a spent weapon cannot fire.
mission: any mission without an environment, player turn 1-3. Uses a temporary player-team PunchMech pawn given Brute_Heavyrocket (Limited = 1).
observe: Before: the helper pawn's shots_remaining is 2 (Prime_Punchmech + 1 rocket use).
After the shot: shots_remaining 1; the Scorpion at (2,5) takes 3 and dies.
Then send FIRE <uid> 2 2 5 by hand: ret should be 0 (no uses left).
Squad check (no scenario needed): if a squad mech has a limited weapon, fire it and see weapon_slots[].uses drop by 1 (uses_basis 'calibrated').
